cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
SoduWork 日增 +1,778 星
四天里从 305 涨到 1,567
cover.dek: 这个自托管、支持多 harness 的多 Agent 团队引擎，近 4 天日增一路加速，今天升到 +1,778，连续 10 天达标。11-17 它还在新秀榜，现在已居日榜首位。
cover.title_en:
SoduWork adds 1,778 stars a day
up from 305 four days ago
cover.dek_en: The self-hosted, multi-harness engine for teams of agents has accelerated for four straight days and is now at +1,778. It was on the rookie list on 11-17 and now sits first on the daily chart.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: 一篇论文发现，没有反馈的自进化会让 Skills 在 SkillsBench 上平均掉 15 分。
stickers.text_en: One paper finds that self-evolution without feedback costs Skills 15 points on average on SkillsBench.

stickers.title: 回落快
stickers.text: Chrome 的 modern-web-guidance 11-14 日增 +4,133，现在只剩 +595。
stickers.text_en: Chrome's modern-web-guidance gained +4,133 stars a day on 11-14 and is down to +595 now.

stickers.title: 榜单合集
stickers.text: rust-anything 日增 +1,515，曝光主要来自一个 YouTube 合集（▶7552），HN 上 1 分 0 评。
stickers.text_en: rust-anything gains +1,515 a day, mostly from one YouTube roundup (▶7552). Its HN post has 1 point and 0 comments.
